format: Each step: dir (host->device | device->host), endpoint (bulk_out=EP 0x03, bulk_in=EP 0x82, interrupt_in=EP 0x81, 16-byte packets), hex (exact bytes of one USB transfer), annotation. provenance: 'verhue-capture' = hex dump found in Verhue's sources (probably captured from the official editor), 'clavia-derived' = built from the Clavia v1.62 serializers, 'verhue-derived' = built from Verhue's builders, 'synthetic' = device reply invented to match the decoded layout (field values arbitrary but legal).

steps.annotation: Patch upload into slot A = one bubble: hdr 0x28, sess 0x53 (void | 19 molecules: 37, 21, 4A x2, 69, 52 x2, 4D x3, 65, 62, 60, 5B x3, 5A x2, 6F), payload = '37 00 00 00 <str16 name>' followed by the 18 .pch2 sections (each: id, u16be length, body; 4D sections carry 10 variations over USB). Verhue hard-codes the 0x53 byte. Frame bytes depend on the patch, so only the prefix is given.
Performance upload: hdr 0x2C, sess 0x42 (void | 2 molecules: 37 + 1A). 1A wraps 29 name, 11 section, 4 x patch sections, 5F section.
Download: CMCompletePatchRequest slot A. Reply (hdr 0x08, sess 0x11) = 21 ... 6F sections (Verhue: optionally '2D 00' after 21)
